candidate: Open-Meteo ERA5 weather in main LightGBM

training: Same prepared Jan/Jul populations, exclusions and targets as v58
clock: latest UTC hour at or before movement time, max age 1 hour
accumulations: 6/24/48 preceding hourly precipitation mm and snowfall cm; require complete windows
validation: Mean January/July RMSE; paired day bootstrap; seed and airport diagnostics
limitations: Reused development months; seed agreement is not independent validation
ERA5 is retrospective reanalysis, not a contemporaneously available forecast
screening: Run seed 42 first. Continue seeds 142/242 only for Jan/Jul mean improvement of at least 0.02 seconds; this is a compute screen, not evidence of independent confirmation.
